IRS990.MissionDesc: THE JACK IN THE BOX FOUNDATION'S MISSION IS TO HELP PEOPLE ACCESS AND EXPLORE LIFE OUTSIDE THE BOX. THE FOUNDATION CHAMPIONS THE SUCCESS OF OTHERS, WITH A FOCUS ON FEEDING, EDUCATING, AND EMPOWERING KIDS AND FAMILIES. OUR PRIMARY COMMUNITY PARTNER IS SHARE OUR STRENGTH/NO KID HUNGRY, ALONG WITH 100+ LOCAL, YOUTH-SERVING NONPROFITS ACROSS JACK IN THE BOX RESTAURANT COMMUNITIES.
IRS990.Desc: JACK IN THE BOX FOUNDATION ("FOUNDATION") CONTRIBUTES MONEY AND VOLUNTEER TIME TO 501(C)(3) ORGANIZATIONS THAT FEED, EDUCATE, AND EMPOWER YOUTH. DURING THE FISCAL YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024, THE FOUNDATION CONTRIBUTED $2,646,516 WORTH OF GRANTS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: JACK IN THE BOX FOUNDATION ("FOUNDATION") PROVIDES SHORT-TERM FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE UP TO $2,000 TO EMPLOYEES OF ITS RELATED AFFILIATE, JACK IN THE BOX INC. OR ITS SUBSIDIARIES OR FRANCHISEES, WHO ARE IMPACTED BY UNANTICIPATED AND UNAVOIDABLE EMERGENCIES THAT CAUSE FINANCIAL HARDSHIP AND ARE NOT OTHERWISE COVERED BY INSURANCE, GOVERNMENTAL OR PRIVATE AGENCIES OR THROUGH THEIR OWN PERSONAL FINANCIAL RESOURCES.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: LINE 1 INCLUDES $1,585,278 IN AGENCY FUND TRANSACTIONS. THE FOUNDATION FUNDRAISES ACROSS ALL JACK IN THE BOX INC. RESTAURANT LOCATIONS INCLUDING FRANCHISED LOCATIONS IN ORDER TO GENERATE SPONSORED CONTRIBUTIONS TO BE REMITTED DIRECTLY TO THE PARTNER ORGANIZATION AT THE END OF THE SPONSORSHIP PERIOD. THE FOUNDATION HELPED TO FACILITATE THE FUNDRAISER WITHIN JACK IN THE BOX LOCATIONS AND BASE THE CONTRIBUTIONS TO BE A PART OF THEIR TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS GENERATED FOR THE TAX PERIOD. FOR FISCAL YEAR ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2024, THE FOUNDATION AND JACK IN THE BOX INC PARTNERED WITH SHARE OUR STRENGTH -NO KID HUNGARY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION IS EXEMPT FROM TAXATION UNDER SECTION 501(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE AND IS GENERALLY NOT SUBJECT TO FEDERAL OR STATE INCOME TAXES. HOWEVER, THE FOUNDATION IS SUBJECT TO INCOME TAXES ON ANY NET INCOME THAT IS DERIVED FROM UNRELATED BUSINESS ACTIVITY AND NOT IN FURTHERANCE OF THE PURPOSES FOR WHICH IT WAS GRANTED EXEMPTION. NO INCOME TAX PROVISION HAS BEEN RECORDED, AS THE NET INCOME, IF ANY, FROM ANY UNRELATED TRADE OR BUSINESS, IN THE OPINION OF MANAGEMENT, IS NOT MATERIAL TO THE ACCOMPANYING FINANCIAL STATEMENTS TAKE AS A WHOLE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 1A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AUTHORITY IS GIVEN TO THE SUBDIVISIONS (AS PER THE REVISED BY-LAWS) TO OPERATE UNDER INDEPENDENT COMMITTEES WHICH STILL REPORT TO AND ARE REQUIRED TO GET AUTHORIZATION FROM THE OVERALL FOUNDATION BOARD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION'S AUDIT COMMITTEE REVIEWS THE FORM 990 BASED UPON THE AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND ALL OTHER AVAILABLE DOCUMENTATION TO ENSURE THE COMPLETENESS AND ACCURACY OF THE FORMS PRIOR TO THEM BEING SUBMITTED TO THE FOUNDATION'S BOARD FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL. THE AUDIT COMMITTEE CONSISTS OF INDIVIDUALS WITH THE APPROPRIATE KNOWLEDGE (BOTH CURRENT AND HISTORICAL) OF THE FOUNDATION'S OPERATIONS AS WELL AS THE TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED TO APPROPRIATELY REVIEW THE FORMS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE MEMBERS OF THE FOUNDATION'S GOVERNING BODY ARE REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST BEFORE ANY ISSUES REQUIRING THEIR VOTE ARE CONSIDERED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION UTILIZES SHARED RESOURCES OF ITS RELATED ENTITY, JACK IN THE BOX INC. (FEIN 95-2698708), AND ALL COMPENSATION AND RELATED PAYROLL AND BENEFIT EXPENSES ARE THE FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF THE RELATED ENTITY, NOT THE FOUNDATION. THE RELATED ENTITY, AS A PUBLICLY TRADED COMPANY LISTED ON NASDAQ WITH INDEPENDENT BOARD OVERSIGHT UPON EXECUTIVE AND EMPLOYEE COMPENSATION, IS COMMITTED TO PROVIDING A FAIR AND COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION STRUCTURE FOR ITS WORKFORCE. THE RELATED ENTITY ENGAGES BOTH INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL COMPENSATION EXPERTS TO DETERMINE FAIR, EQUITABLE, AND MARKET COMPETITIVE TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGES FOR ALL OF ITS EMPLOYEES INCLUDING THE EMPLOYEE(S) IT SHARES WITH THE FOUNDATION. THE PROCESS DESCRIBED HERE WAS LAST COMPLETED IN 2024.
